name: Rent split
summary: Splits rent by room size, private bath and parking, and locks once every room agrees.
useWhen: housemates deciding rent for rooms of different sizes
'how do we split rent', 'my room is smaller', 'whoever gets the bathroom pays more'
dontUseWhen: splitting one bill evenly (use a bill split)
picking who gets which room (use a draft or wheel)
settling IOUs after a trip (use settle-up)

name.description: Who has the room, as in the chat, or empty

sqft.description: Room size in square feet, 40 to 2000

weight.description: How much size counts, 0 to 100 in steps of 5; default 60

bathCents.description: Extra for a private bath, 0 to 30000. Only an amount a person wrote in the chat; 0 otherwise (someone saying they should pay more for it is bath: true on their room with this at 0)

parkingCents.description: Extra for parking, 0 to 15000. Only an amount a person wrote in the chat; 0 otherwise
